column1: # The rooms' settings (docs/notes/rooms.md) and Player vs Bots' (docs/notes/player_bots.md), one
# config: gameplay/srp/rooms.options. srp reads it from its game data at start (a key missing stops
# it), the lobby movie through exe patch 94 (SrpData.rooms). A list is a row per item ([0], [1], ...).
#   size_least, size_most    each side's players a room may have
#   min_side_most            the players a side a room may need before its vote begins: 1 v 1 to this
#   level_most               the highest max level a room may have (the highest equipment level)
#   waits[]                  the waits before a match a room may have, seconds, ascending
#   default_*                the create window's settings before a player has made a room, and the
#                            room Play makes (max level 0: any; Play's is its equipment bracket's)
#   vote_s                   the vote's own time before each match, whatever the wait
#   after_match_s            what the vote after a match has more (its players back from the results)
#   late_join_wait_s         a member who comes while its room's match is played sees the room this
#                            long before it is put into the match
#   scale_players            this many ready Play users waiting in one equipment bracket open a room
#   rooms_most               the most rooms at once
#   match_start_wait_ms      with no countdown this long after a match's first entry, it starts with
#   pvb/sizes[]              Player vs Bots: the team sizes offered
#   pvb/default_size         the one the window shows first
#   pvb/max_gear             the highest equipment level let in (the bots wear the player's)
